dedupe_keys.name: cemaden interactive map of the natural disaster risk observation network brazil

description: The interactive map of CEMADEN, the Brazilian National Centre for Monitoring and Early Warning of Natural Disasters, shows the observation network the centre uses to monitor natural disaster risk. Its menus include weather radars, stations of the monitoring network, a set of additional layers, active layers with legends, a data download section, help and a search. Access to the map and its download section is free and public; no licence is stated on the page read. Caveats: the page is in Portuguese and loads its layers by script, so the station types and periods available for download are set out in the download section, not on the page itself. Coverage is Brazil. It supports hazard exposure analysis and early warning studies for landslides, flash floods and droughts that affect roads, housing and other infrastructure, using radar and station observations; the related record is the CEMADEN integrated drought index for Brazil catalogued by another piece, which it complements.
